items.text: V53 is the visible canonical frontend base; do not redesign it in Part 2.
V23 remains physics oracle and rollback donor, not visible current.
EXISTS != PARTICIPATES; stored material is not automatic context.
LOCAL privacy inherits through lineage and export fails closed.
Capture is Human-intent input; Capture, transcript, Patent and transport status never become Current/Human Accepted/Served authority by existence alone.
Supabase is private Capture transport/status cache, not product source, Current Graph or receipt authority.
Prometeo shell v1/v2/v3 are candidate donors. Observed Served v2 participation and published v3 asset do not make either accepted visual authority.
Primary Navigator Capture must reuse explicit Input Ownership/Focus Lease and integrate through the V53 host/adapter grammar instead of creating an uncontrolled second global shell.
LOCAL Capture material requires an explicit exact-scope Human export/declassification decision before external Patent transport; opaque token possession is not declassification.
Recent-ten/rolling-summary metabolism preserves exact capture revision provenance; rolling summaries are DERIVED_EVIDENCE and watermarks advance only after durable covered-summary writes.
